description:
William Phillips’ The Ash Remains is an epic, action packed, novel that mixes gritty soldiery with majestic dragon riding. Maintaining roots to classic fantasy while adding a fair bit of modern darkness—and a stunning ending—The Ash Remains is a winner for readers who want a multi-POV dragon rider fantasy that feels both familiar and fresh.  […]
